title: Assessable Trait Parameters
description: Configuration contract for the Assessable trait: which result states the source of truth writes as items rather than only as counts.

recordedStates.description: The result states the source writes as items. Stage1's a11y evidence writes violations as items and needs-review, passed and not-applicable only as page-level counts.

items.description: A result state: violation, passed, needs_review, not_applicable or not_measured.
